value.feedback: QLDAPM-E2E-20261101-POST-ROLLOUT-001: Add GET /tasks/{task_id} to retrieve one existing task by numeric ID. Return the existing id, title and status fields, or HTTP 404 if the task is absent. Add focused automated tests including persistence and invalid or absent IDs. Preserve GET /tasks/summary, /healthz, CRUD and search; do not change the database schema. Produce one isolated feature branch and PR, do not merge.

scope: Them phuong thuc GET /tasks/{task_id} tren ung dung FastAPI
Bosung bai kiem thu tu dong cho viec lay chi tiet task va xu ly ID khong ton tai hoac khong hop le
Dam bao khong thay doi schema co so du lieu SQLite hien tai
api_behavior: GET /tasks/{task_id} tra ve ma 200 kem JSON chua id, title va status neu task ton tai
GET /tasks/{task_id} tra ve ma 404 neu task_id khong ton tai trong CSDL
GET /tasks/{task_id} tra ve ma 422 neu task_id khong phai la so hop le
edge_cases: Truy van voi task_id la chuoi chu cai hoac ky tu dac biet tra ve ma loi 422
Truy van task_id co gia tri so am hoac qua lon khong co trong CSDL tra ve ma loi 404
acceptance: AC1: GET /tasks/{id} tra ve HTTP 200 va thong tin task gom id, title, status khi ID ton tai
AC2: GET /tasks/{id} tra ve HTTP 404 khi ID khong ton tai trong CSDL
AC3: GET /tasks/{id} tra ve HTTP 422 khi ID khong phai la kieu so nguyen hop le
AC4: Tat ca cac tinh nang cu nhu GET /tasks/summary, /healthz, CRUD, search va schema SQLite giu nguyen khong thay doi
limitations: Khong thay doi schema co so du lieu SQLite
Khong tu dong merge nhanh hoac pull request
